welcome.title: Welcome to Streets!
welcome.description: In Streets, you line up what you want to see in columns and build your own timeline. Here's a quick look at how it works.

columns.title: These are columns
columns.descriptionWide: Timelines, notifications and more each flow in their own column. Click a post to open it and see the replies.
columns.descriptionNarrow: Timelines, notifications and more each flow in their own column. Tap the icons below or swipe left and right to move between columns.

addColumn.title: Add the columns you like
addColumn.description: Add a user's posts, hashtag search results, or anything else you're curious about as a new column.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Change your theme, relays, mutes, profile and more here. You can replay this tour anytime.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: Adding columns, search and settings are in this menu. You can replay this tour anytime.
